The machine is on a wooden table with various sewing accessories and threads around it. The background is cluttered with fabrics and household items.

Photo 1 shows a wider view of the same sewing machine on a metal stand with a foot pedal. The surrounding area is a workshop or storage space with fabrics, bags, and other items. The machine appears to be in a used condition with visible dust and wear.

Photo 2 is a close-up of the motor label. The brand 'GLÜCK' is visible in red, followed by 'CLUTCH MOTOR'. The model is 'DOL-38GL', 250W, 220V, 50Hz, 2850 RPM. The label is metallic and affixed to the motor housing.
